group: The Rural Hospital Efficiency Fund cohort -- ELEVEN NAMED HOSPITALS, AND NOT AWARDS
why: All eleven are real, named Maine rural hospitals, all eleven are in DHHS's own 2026-07-31 release, and RCJ carries every one at an amount of $1. THE NAMES ARE EXACTLY RIGHT -- they match DHHS's roster NAME FOR NAME, eleven of eleven, once an en dash is normalised, which is this file's only independent reading of the parse. WHAT IS WRONG IS THE KIND OF ACTION: DHHS 'identified and invited' them, its own advisory deck says the 'award amount and approved budget will be confirmed after start of participation', and the funding milestone is FALL/WINTER. This is MISSOURI'S DEFECT A SECOND TIME -- the wrong KIND of action, published as a $1 placeholder so no amount check can see it -- and it is worse here, because in Missouri 14 of 27 roster rows were hospitals and in Maine ELEVEN OF ELEVEN are. An extractor built from this candidate list would have published eleven named Maine hospitals as RHTP recipients on the strength of a $1 figure.

group: Maine's Revised Year 1 Budget Narrative -- plan lines, not awards
why: 3 rows, new on the 2026-09-24 pull, from 'State of Maine - Revised Year 1 Budget Narrative': Medical Care Development $33,821,698; Medical Care Development $12,222,021; University of New England $12,058,319. A revised budget narrative is the state's PLAN (§0.3), so each is a Tier 2 line against the partner the plan names, not an award action. Medical Care Development is MCD Global Health, whose own archived page says it 'was selected to lead digital health, AI, and digital infrastructure activities under the Technology and Innovation Initiative' -- a named partner in the plan, and its sub-awards (EMR Modernization, applications closed 8/14) have named nobody. The University of New England line, $12,058,319, is NOT DHHS's announced $12,000,000 -- the one award this file carries, from DHHS's own archived blog post -- and adding the two would count one partnership twice. The narrative itself is not in this repository's evidence archive; the verdict rests on the document's kind and on the archived announcement.

group: A third-party digest -- fund uses as 'awardees'
why: 3 rows, new on the 2026-09-24 pull, from the digest 'RHT funds: Where they're really going' (RCJ category REPORT; its title carries a 'WV' prefix while the document and its rows are filed under Maine): 'EHR infrastructure in rural Maine' $30,000,000; 'Maine community health workforce and practice infrastructure' $12,000,000; 'Maine rural hospitals (collective)' $30,000,000. Every 'awardee' is a FUND USE or a class (§6.1 PROGRAM_NAME_AS_AWARDEE), and every figure is a pool this file already records from DHHS's own documents -- EMR modernization, the Rural Hospital Efficiency Fund and the UNE partnership. The 'collective' rural-hospital row is the RHEF pool again: counting it would publish the invited cohort's $30M as awarded (§0.3). THIRD_PARTY_NEWS alone can never support a row (§8).

group: University of New England -- the one real award, at DHHS's figure
why: RCJ carried $12,000,000 for UNE on the 2026-08-27 pull -- DHHS's own '$12 million' exactly, the ONE Maine candidate that was an award action this repository can evidence -- and WITHDREW that row on the 2026-09-24 pull.
